attchmntText: Prakash Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Prakash Industries Limited published unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026, approved by the Board of Directors on 12th November 2026. The results were published in Business Standard newspapers on 13th November 2026. For the quarter ended 30th September 2026, total income from operations was 24.47 lakhs. Profit after tax was 6.49 lakhs. Earnings per share was 0.93 rupees. For the half year ended 30th September 2026, total income from operations was 28.61 lakhs. Loss after tax was 42.51 lakhs. Earnings per share was negative 6.07 rupees. Lerthai Finance Limited also reported results for the same period. Total income from operations was 16.27 lakhs for the quarter ended 30th September 2025. Loss after tax was 2.57 lakhs. Earnings per share was negative 0.37 rupees.

attchmntText: Prakash Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "Press Release".
voiceSummary: Prakash Industries Limited filed a press release regarding financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026. Net sales for the quarter were 896 crores, up 24 percent from the previous year. EBITDA was 149 crores, up 30 percent. Profit after tax was 65 crores, compared to 62 crores in the prior year. The company adopted the new tax regime under the Income Tax Act, 2025, effective 1st April, 2026. For the half year, net sales reached 1928 crores, a 10 percent increase. EBITDA was 303 crores, a 17 percent increase. The company extracted approximately 2.81 lac MT of coal from its Bhaskarpara Coal Mine during the quarter. It aims to achieve coal extraction of 1.2 Mn tonnes in FY2027, against 1.0 Mn tonnes in the previous financial year.

attchmntText: Prakash Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Prakash Industries Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 during a Board Meeting held on 12th November 2026. The company reported a profit after tax of 6,537 lakhs for the quarter and 13,664 lakhs for the half year. Net sales for the quarter stood at 89,612 lakhs, while total revenue was 90,332 lakhs. Earnings per share were 3.65 for the quarter. The Board also approved the statement of assets and liabilities and cash flow as at 30th September 2026. Total assets were recorded at 5,03,324 lakhs. The financial results were reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board. The statutory auditors have reviewed these results pursuant to SEBI regulations. The company operates in the Iron and Steel segment.
